item.title: Show HN: Proxy-or-Not, Proxy Detector
item.summary: My humble attempt to detect residential proxies while limiting false positives on things like CGNAT. So far, its pretty successful detecting SOAX, BrightData, and a custom proxy app I built for my phone - but I have a pretty limited sample size. Give it a spin! * https://github.com/JWally/sofa-king-bad-box * https://github.com/JWally/sofa-king-bad-box-android Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49227962 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
